title: Jeju in winter: a 7-day route by bus and on foot
desc: A week of winter stops around Jeju Island, from Jeju City to Udo, Seongsan, Hamdeok and Seogwipo, organised by day.

items.title: Dongmun Traditional Market (동문재래시장)
items.memo: Big Jeju City market; street food like abalone gimbap and dol hareubang bread

items.title: Magpie Brewery & Taproom
items.memo: Brewery with Korean-inspired beers, pizza and fried chicken

items.title: Udo Lighthouse (우도등대)
items.memo: Hilltop lighthouse at Udo's southern tip, on the island walk

items.title: Seongsan Ilchulbong (성산일출봉)
items.memo: UNESCO volcanic crater and a top sunrise spot; go early to climb

items.title: Hamdeok Beach (함덕해수욕장)
items.memo: Golden sand set against black volcanic rocks

items.title: Cafe Del Mundo (카페 델문도)
items.memo: Waterside cafe at Hamdeok known for fresh bakes

items.title: Manjanggul Lava Tube (만장굴)
items.memo: One of the world's longest lava tubes; walk in to the lava column

items.title: Jeju Folk Village, Pyoseon (제주민속촌)
items.memo: Traditional Jeju houses; camellias bloom here in winter

items.title: Seogwipo Maeil Olle Market (서귀포매일올레시장)
items.memo: Seogwipo's big traditional market; good at night and for souvenirs

items.title: Yakcheonsa Temple (약천사)
items.memo: Temple with palm trees and a cave shrine; start of Olle Trail 8

items.title: Jusangjeolli Cliff (주상절리대)
items.memo: Hexagonal basalt columns along Olle Trail 8

items.title: Lee Jung-seop Art Street (이중섭거리)
items.memo: The painter's house, museum and murals in central Seogwipo

items.title: Jeongbang Waterfall (정방폭포)
items.memo: Waterfall dropping over black cliffs straight onto the shore

items.title: Oedolgae Rock (외돌개)
items.memo: Lone sea stack, about 30 min walk from Cheonjiyeon on Olle Trail 7
